author: official
summary: Counts down to a deadline in the visitor’s browser, as plain digits or split-flap cards, and hides or swaps itself at the deadline.

attributes.name: data-deadline
attributes.description: ISO date-time WITH an explicit offset (Z or ±hh:mm); without one the root is left as authored.

attributes.name: data-expired
attributes.description: What the root does at the deadline: hide it, or replace its content with data-expired-text.

attributes.name: data-expired-text
attributes.description: Text shown in place of the countdown when data-expired is text.

attributes.name: data-part
attributes.description: On a child element: which unit it shows. Two digits minimum; days grow to three when needed.

attributes.name: data-flip
attributes.description: On a data-part element: show one split-flap card per digit instead of plain text.
